checks.name: an agent (or any local program) cannot mint an owner session: without the launch secret the session route answers 401 and sets no cookie
a grant limited to certain tracks cannot change things outside clips through side doors: upload, analysis data and sound-effect import are refused as out of scope
an agent cannot reverse the owner's transaction by naming its id; the owner can
a grant limited to one project cannot show presence in, or read controls of, another project through MCP
an agent cannot cancel a job the owner started; the owner can cancel it
deleting a project and cleaning storage are owner-only: an editing agent gets 403 for delete, clean-up and the storage report; the owner needs the exact project name
a playlist file (which could point at other files or URLs) is not accepted as media
Pause Agent (clicked in the editor): agent edits, jobs and proposals are refused server-side with agent_paused; reading and the owner's own edits continue
while paused, every job-starting or requesting route refuses agents too (retry, browser export, model request)
an agent cannot resume itself, create grants, or decide proposals and approvals
Resume is a deliberate owner action; afterwards the agent can edit again
a proposal written against older text goes stale instead of overwriting the owner's newer wording
agents cannot accept proposals (their own or anyone's)
approvals: an agent can request a model download but cannot approve it or start it; a rejected request cannot be reused
a project-limited grant sees only its project (REST and MCP lists), cannot create projects, and cannot read another project's job by id
a revoked grant stops working immediately (401 grant_revoked)
grant tokens are never returned again after creation

every response carries nosniff, no-referrer and a frame ban; pages allow only same-origin scripts (no inline, eval or blob:), no plugins and no framing; API and media responses allow nothing and are sandboxed
